mechanism: Nitrofurantoin may increase haloperidol levels through inhibition of CYP3A4 and potential renal clearance effects, while haloperidol increases CNS depression risk and may lower seizure threshold in patients predisposed to nitrofurantoin-induced neurotoxicity.
action: Monitor for increased haloperidol adverse effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation, orthostasis); consider haloperidol dose reduction if used concurrently; counsel on CNS depression risks.
